description: Translates an id from another catalog into the Flipzi card id: a pokemontcg.io id (e.g. "sv3-125", English Pokemon), a Cardmarket idProduct (any game; may return several cards bound to one product) or a TCGplayer product id (the number in tcgplayer.com/product/<id>). Give exactly one. An id Flipzi cannot verify answers CARD_NOT_FOUND. Available on the free plan. Cost: 1 unit.

tcgplayer_id.description: TCGplayer product id, digits only, e.g. "254761".

name: flipzi_lookup_card
title: Card id from another catalog
